name: Rowland Heights Fall A 2026

venue.name: Tawa Marketplace Rowland Heights
venue.address: Mandarin Plaza, 1015 S Nogales St, Rowland Heights, CA 91748

information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RowlandHeightsFallA2026#76810-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). **This competition is run in series with [Rowland Heights Fall B 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RowlandHeightsFallB2026).** You can only register for one of the two competitions! **This competition takes place in a public marketplace, so expect the venue to be noisy, and prepare accordingly.** **This competition will use running judges for all rounds.** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
